description: This file defines the OrderEntity class, which extends the Order class and implements Serializable. It includes fields related to order totals, payment information, shipping, order status, and purchase date, along with their respective getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OrderEntity
classes.description: A Java class representing an order entity with additional order details such as totals, payment info, and status.

methods.name: setTotals
methods.description: Sets the list of order totals.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Returns the list of order totals.

methods.name: getPaymentType
methods.description: Gets the payment type used for the order.

methods.name: setPaymentType
methods.description: Sets the payment type for the order.

methods.name: getCreditCard
methods.description: Returns the credit card information associated with the order.

methods.name: setCreditCard
methods.description: Sets the credit card information for the order.

methods.name: getDatePurchased
methods.description: Returns the date when the order was purchased.

methods.name: setDatePurchased
methods.description: Sets the date when the order was purchased.

methods.name: setPreviousOrderStatus
methods.description: Sets the list of previous order statuses.

methods.name: getPreviousOrderStatus
methods.description: Returns the list of previous order statuses.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency code for the order.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency code for the order.
